environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate tasks within a private subnet (no IGW route). Traffic ingress is handled by an internal NLB (scheme=internal) registered to a VPC endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f). Consumer applications connect via interface VPC endpoint in their respective VPCs. The NLB has no public DNS resolution — Route53 private hosted zone resolves api.orders.internal to the NLB's private IPs only within associated VPCs. SQS access uses a com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sqs gateway endpoint with a restrictive endpoint policy scoped to the specific queue ARN. The ECS task security group only permits ingress from the NLB's ENI security group on port 8080. There is no NAT gateway or internet path from the subnet hosting the tasks.
